using subquery through command prompt


-mysql -u rppt -p

-use ord_mgmt;
-show tables;


SELECT * FROM PRODUCT
WHERE prod_price>(SELECT prod_price FROM Product
                  WHERE prod_desc LIKE '%TV%');

This will show error as the subquery contains the output more than 1 row.


# to mke use of the innner subquery we use the keywords like 'ALL','ANY'.

SELECT * FROM PRODUCT
WHERE prod_price>ALL(SELECT prod_price FROM Product
                  WHERE prod_desc LIKE '%TV%');
 output- prices more than all the output of the subquery
